summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend test of ANCRSync MVP. All 15 pytest backend tests pass (auth, workspaces, studios seeding, sessions, passport, global creators, AI chat with Claude Sonnet 4.5, dashboard). Full e2e frontend flow validated: signup -> dashboard stats -> workspace CRUD + tasks + comments + AI suggest -> studios list/filter/room with mocked chat -> sessions create + AI summary -> global map with pins and filters -> passport with auto-logged entries -> AI intelligence chat with context. Two minor UX/testid issues found.

ui_bugs.issue: The Sonner welcome toast (top-right) can overlap and intercept clicks on data-testid="new-workspace-btn" immediately after signup redirect. The empty-state button data-testid="empty-new-workspace-btn" works reliably. Consider moving toast to bottom or delaying toast render, or increasing button z-index above toaster.

action_items: Optional: Prevent the 'Welcome to ANCRSync' Sonner toast from overlapping the top-right 'New workspace' button (either lower toast z-index/position or raise button z-index).

Optional testid alignment: /studios page uses data-testid="studio-<uuid>" for cards; if the intent is a consistent 'studio-card-*' prefix across app, rename to data-testid="studio-card-<uuid>". Dashboard already uses studio-card-<id>.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/feedback returns {**doc, "_id": None} which leaks a null _id field. Consider omitting instead.
server.py is 532 lines - still manageable but nearing the split threshold; consider modularising by domain (auth, workspaces, studios, sessions, ai) as it grows.
server.py: uses deprecated FastAPI on_event('shutdown') - migrate to lifespan handlers for future FastAPI versions.
CORS is wide-open ('*'). Acceptable for preview but tighten before prod.
JWT_SECRET has a dev default; enforce env presence in production build.
test_credentials: Created ephemeral users via UI signup (qa+<uuid>@ancrsync.co / Test1234!). demo@ancrsync.co / Demo1234! not pre-seeded - users must be created via /signup.
seed_data_creation: Studios auto-seeded via GET /api/studios (verified 10 default studios). No manual seed required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core flows work end-to-end. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py cover full API surface incl. Claude Sonnet 4.5 AI endpoints. If retesting, note toast may temporarily overlap /workspaces top-right button right after signup; use empty-new-workspace-btn or wait ~3s for toast to clear.
rca of the issue: Toast overlap: react-hot/sonner toaster is positioned top-right (default) at same corner as 'New workspace' primary button on Workspaces page. When redirected to /dashboard then /workspaces immediately after signup, the toast is still visible over the button. Playwright click with force=True still targets pointer coords which the toast intercepts. Fix: move Toaster to bottom-right, or dismiss toast on route change, or set pointer-events: none on toast wrapper.
